2790.title: Claude resume transcript integrity
2790.rootCauseOneLine: The bundled Claude SDK retained the tested trailing tool result; the exact failing transcript is absent.
2790.proposedFix: Do not change code without the exact redacted transcript. Replay that transcript through the local mock endpoint first.
2790.caveats: The test covers a valid transcript whose last persisted entry is a tool result. Other parent chains, compact entries, or concurrent appends remain unverified.
